title: Firefox 157 will include JPEG XL by default on all platforms
summary: Firefox 157 will enable JPEG XL image format support by default across all platforms, marking a significant milestone for the modern image format that offers better compression and quality than traditional JPEG/PNG.
problem_solved: Provides native browser support for JPEG XL, a modern image format with superior compression efficiency, lossless recompression, and HDR capabilities.
why_valuable: JPEG XL adoption in major browsers like Firefox will enable faster web page loads with better image quality, reducing bandwidth costs and improving user experience.
